name: Buddhir Balam Yasho Dhairyam
text:
बुद्धिर्बलं यशो धैर्यं निर्भयत्वमरोगता ।
अजाड्यं वाक्पटुत्वं च हनुमत्स्मरणाद्भवेत् ॥
meaning: Through remembering Hanuman, one seeks intelligence, strength, courage, fearlessness, health, alertness and clear speech.
purpose: A verse listing qualities associated with Hanuman’s remembrance.
supports: Confidence; resilience; speaking clearly; steady effort.
when: Before a performance, interview, examination or difficult conversation.
